title: Filings: a group of major music publishers has agreed to end a copyright infringement dispute with X over the use of their music on the social media platform (Blake Brittain/Reuters)
summary: Blake Brittain / Reuters: Filings: a group of major music publishers has agreed to end a copyright infringement dispute with X over the use of their music on the social media platform — A group of major music publishers including Universal Music Group (UMG.AS) and Sony Music (6758.T) have agreed to end a legal dispute …
